newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur sees five-10 pct premium growth.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur sees five-10 pct premium growth.

text.p: Winterthur Group said on Thursdasy it expected a growth in premium income of between five and 10 percent in local currencies in 1997.
Chairman Peter Spaelti told a news conference that in 1996 Winterthur's gross premiums rose 16.3 percent to 25.9 billion Swiss francs.
Seperately, Spaelti said that the group's current strategy called for growth primarily based on organic growth, but it would not rule out acquisitions should opportunities arise.
"I don't rule out acquisition, but today nothing is in the pipeline," Spaelti said in response to a question.
He also said the company had the required authorised capital to take advantage of any opportunity that may arise, although the focus was currently on organic growth.
